bio_am: Ծնած է 1889-ին Սասունի Ահարոնք գիւղը։ Շիրակի նահանգապետ, Հայրենիքի Փրկութեան Կոմիտէի ներքին նախարար (1921), մահացած է Պէյրութ՝ 1977-ին։
bio_en: Karo (Karapet) Sasuni was born in 1889 in the village of Aharonk in Sasun, studied at the Murad-Mkhitarian school in Mush under Gegham Ter-Karapetian and Galust Andreasian, and joined the ARF in Mush in 1904. He taught in Tigranakert in 1906-08, then studied at the Central school and the law faculty in Constantinople, graduating in 1914 after a year back in Sasun in 1913. During the First World War he worked for Western Armenian refugees in the Caucasus; in 1917 he joined the ARF Bureau of Armenia, and under the Republic he was a member of parliament, governor of Shirak and, after the February 1921 uprising, interior minister of the Committee of Salvation. In exile he served six terms on the ARF Bureau, wrote extensively on the years 1914-21 and on Armenian-Kurdish relations, and from 1933 lived in Lebanon, teaching at the Palanjian Jemaran and editing Bagin; he died in Beirut on 11 August 1977.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
